title: Liam's May 2026 Field Rules
description: Active governance rules captured by Drew on 2026-05-08. These should drive BSFA's Field Rules engine as warning/blocker rules. Source: Cowork Workflow V1.md (Drive ID 135npwOf6GJd4MyDVkh_KPR3usZ8BavFJ). The BSFA app's CLAUDE.md confirms a Field Rules safety layer exists at src/config/fieldRules.js with these 4 rules.

rules.title: Whisper Flex required on Empire vent-free logs
rules.required_action: Add Whisper Flex line item to quote
rules.exception: Hargrove already includes flex — does not apply to Hargrove vent-free or vented logs
rules.internal_explanation: Whisper Flex is the brand-specific flex connector required for Empire vent-free systems. Forgetting it leads to an incomplete order.
rules.customer_safe_wording: Standard install scope — no customer-facing language needed unless asked

rules.title: Gas insert into ZC fireplace — permanent modification acknowledgement
rules.required_action: Get explicit customer acknowledgement BEFORE order is finalized — fireplace will no longer function as wood-burner; box is being cut and modified permanently
rules.internal_explanation: Installing a gas insert into a ZC prefab fireplace involves cutting/modifying the firebox. This is irreversible. Customer must understand and consent upfront — not after install starts.
rules.customer_safe_wording: We need to share something important about how a gas insert installs in a zero-clearance fireplace. The fireplace gets modified during install, so once we proceed, it can no longer be used as a wood-burning fireplace. We want to make sure you're comfortable with that before we order anything.

rules.title: Millivolt ignition banned in Rockford city limits
rules.required_action: Offer the IPI variant of the same unit + run electric to it
rules.out_of_scope: Outside Rockford city limits: still allowed for now
rules.watch_list: Winnebago County is following — timeline TBD
rules.internal_explanation: Rockford adopted 2024 IL Energy Code section R403.13(1) which prohibits standing-pilot ignition systems in new gas appliance installs.
rules.customer_safe_wording: Per the current Rockford energy code, the standing-pilot version of this unit isn't allowed. The electronic-ignition version is the right path — it'll need power run to it, which I can include in the quote.

rules.title: IRTAX header on every install order
rules.required_action: Switch order header to IRTAX before order is finalized
rules.internal_explanation: IRTAX is the order-header code that triggers Rockford install-tax handling in BisTrack. Setting it after the fact creates corrections.

behavior_in_app.scrub_function: scrubCustomerSafe (refuses to publish string violating banned-phrase rule)
